study: Independent BTCUSDT 1H causal ML-RSI event research
source_study: PR #19; 15M = NO EDGE for tested hypothesis; not rewritten
parity: Exact BackQuant TradingView parity is NOT proven.
candles: Only complete contiguous CLOSED hourly groups of twelve verified public spot 5m bars; no gap interpolation
event_semantics: PR19 causal definitions. CROSS once per color transition; RESUME once after reset of favorable slope in same color; 2-bar variants wait for 2 consecutive favorable hourly slopes; gaps/color changes cancel pending setup
primary_entry: Next 1H open plus adverse slippage. Signal timestamp is end of closed signal hour
close_fill: Sensitivity only: signal close at boundary plus adverse slippage, no favorable intrabar retro-fill
passage_semantics: Conservative failure when both barriers touched in same closed 5m; report ambiguity and neither; denominator all complete horizons
atr_family: 6 one-factor economic runner neighbors: stops .75/1/1.25/1.5 at trail1.5, trails1/2 at stop1; NOT full Cartesian grid
naive_be: One stop1/trail1.5 diagnostic comparator, not selection eligible
color_family: Full position opposite confirmed color exit with no initial stop or .75/1/1.25/1.5 ATR stop; 72h cap. Only no-stop and stop1 eligible, other stops neighbors
other_baselines: stop1ATR fixed1R/fixed2R/fixed3R; TP1 economic BE then opposite-color runner with stop1ATR
economic_be: WHOLE-trade net PnL=0 after TP1, including entry fee, actual partial fee, expected remaining exit fee and stop slippage. Realized TP1 profit credited. May be below entry for LONG/above for SHORT; never widens initial stop
atr: Wilder ATR14 from CLOSED 1H; frozen at signal for all risk distances and trail
trailing: Best favorable price on completed 5m bar; tightened level active next 5m, never retrospectively; never widens
ambiguity: Stop first for stop+target collision; TP1+new BE collision conservatively exits runner; unreachable BE exits runner at TP1 instead of inventing a fill
fee_note: VIP1-like taker assumption, configurable; not a verified account tier or permanent fee promise
funding_and_basis: Excluded: underlying spot-return study, not realized/executable Bitunix futures PnL
selection: Per event/confirmation, maximize minimum TRAIN and VALIDATION mean net across eligible models, n>=100 completed in both; no filters selected; default primary if insufficient development samples. Persist code/protocol/dataset hashes before TEST
control: Seed773, replacement, one non-event timestamp per event matched EXACT year/month, UTC hour, CLOSED 4H close/SMA200 regime and TRAIN-frozen volatility quartile. Exclude union of 1/2-bar event timestamps. Unmatched strata disclosed
alignment: Diagnostic only: LONG 4H or1D close>SMA200; SHORT close<SMA200; report unfiltered/4H/1D/both; no filter chosen
volatility: ATR14/closed1H price quartile cutpoints calculated from TRAIN only and frozen for validation/test
capital: Independent possibly overlapping event metrics; separate non-overlapping 1x sequential MaxDD/return, no leverage/liquidation
bootstrap: 1000 weekly-block draws seed773; paired-control advantages assigned to original event week
promotion: Preselected model requires positive min development mean and TEST mean, n>=100, PF>=1.1, positive stressed mean, positive mean without best3, positive paired-control advantage with bootstrap lower bound>0, positive bootstrap lower bound for mean, at least2 positive TEST years and no year below -0.25%, at least75% same-family neighbors positive. Otherwise INTERESTING BUT INCONCLUSIVE if selected TEST expectancy positive; else NO EDGE
scope: No strategy/risk/account mutation/credential/service changes. No deployment/merge; future observer proposal only if genuinely promising
